Having a second player play as your companion without their own Pip-Boy could work with shared vats. Also, if one player leaves a certain radius from the other, shared VATS shouldn't be necessary once the enemies slowed will be too far away for the other player to notice. Sharing the FO4 vats could also be pretty cool as a 2nd player if it slows your aim/movement speed to imply that only the vault-dweller with a pip-boy has time slowed for them.

My best bet (if official multi ever happens) will be the companion thing. Shared vats yes, but as long as the second player is clearly an assistant or companion type, it shouldn't matter that only player 1 has Vats if you're working co-cooperatively in the same battle. Everything else could be kept nearly the same, making it quicker to loot areas or defend/build settlements.

Now, if VATS were to be eliminated totally from Multi, I could see a whole host of ideas for multiplayer:

  • 4 player co-op for defending a settlement against waves - Gears of War style.

  • 8 - 16 player team VS mode (deathmatch, Attack/Defend settlements/cities, capture the Nuka Quantum, etc.)

  • ??? player Giant Mega Deathclaw vs mode (like L4D Tanks or Evolve)

  • ??? player FFA Deathmatch in set locations (Diamond city, Factories, etc)

The way I imagine it, for the above modes requiring PVP, matchmaking could be based on character/mod levels while rewarding players with XP and caps for missions. All this being said, I doubt the current engine will be able to handle more than two players effectively as the gun-play is already pretty shaky for single player.
